camera-pose-over-shoulder.s: a young man in a denim jacket in a sunlit studio, body turned away, looking back over his shoulder at the camera

film-chalky-caricature.w: Exaggerated character studies in chalk and charcoal, only tomato red and black on cream, loose scratchy lines that catch a pose or a sulk in a few strokes.
film-chalky-caricature.a: gestural character caricature in chalky pastel and charcoal, only two inks, tomato red and black, on cream paper, exaggerated proportions, loose scratchy linework, grainy chalk texture, flat red background block
film-chalky-caricature.s: a grumpy chef holding a tiny cake

camera-pose-wall-lean.w: Leaning a shoulder or back on a wall, one foot up against it, hands in pockets.
camera-pose-wall-lean.a: leaning back against a wall, one foot raised flat against it, hands in pockets, head slightly tilted, easy casual stance
camera-pose-wall-lean.s: a woman with short grey hair by a stone wall

film-grainy-oversize-figures.w: Flat figures with huge hands, feet and beaks, shaded only by soft grain, in three saturated colours on cream, with a two-word motto set small in the corner. The strongest ones hang the whole poster on one continuous line: a pour of tea, a thread through a needle, the spiral of a snail shell.
film-grainy-oversize-figures.a: flat vector illustration with grainy noise shading, exaggerated oversized hands, feet and limbs, only three colours (hot pink, emerald green, cobalt blue) plus black, on warm cream paper, generous white space, a short bold sans caption small in the top corner
film-grainy-oversize-figures.s: a gardener carrying a giant watering can

camera-pose-hero.w: Feet planted wide, hands on hips, chest open, chin slightly down: shot from low it reads as a hero.
camera-pose-hero.a: feet planted shoulder-width apart, hands on hips, chest open, chin slightly down, steady gaze, seen from a low angle
camera-pose-hero.s: a tall man in a wool coat on a hill at golden hour

film-cobalt-coast-gouache.w: Flat gouache coastlines under a saturated cobalt sky, towering cream clouds drawn with a few contour lines, terracotta roofs and dark cypresses, a tiny red car or train for scale.
film-cobalt-coast-gouache.a: flat gouache coastline, saturated cobalt sky, tall cream cumulus with thin contour lines, terracotta roofs, dark cypresses, deep blue sea and islands, one small red vehicle, dry-brush paper grain, summer light
film-cobalt-coast-gouache.s: a coastal village with a red bus on a cliff road

camera-pose-seated-three-quarter.w: Seated on a chair turned at an angle, body three-quarters away, face turned back to camera.
camera-pose-seated-three-quarter.a: seated on a chair turned three-quarters away from the camera, one arm over the chair back, face turned toward the lens, upright spine
camera-pose-seated-three-quarter.s: a young woman with curly black hair in a cafe

film-renaissance-oil.w: Oil on panel from the 1400s and 1500s, born in Flanders and carried to Italy: calm pyramidal figure groups, soft sfumato modelling, linear perspective, blue-green distant hills and warm glazed flesh.
film-renaissance-oil.a: Renaissance oil painting on wood panel, soft sfumato modelling, pyramidal figure composition, one-point linear perspective, hazy blue atmospheric hills, warm translucent glazes, ultramarine and vermilion drapery
film-renaissance-oil.s: a young woman in a blue cloak sitting on a stone balcony with a river valley and distant hills behind her

camera-pose-chin-on-hand.w: Elbow on a table, chin resting on the back of the hand or the fingers, eyes away or on the lens.
camera-pose-chin-on-hand.a: elbow resting on a table, chin resting on the back of the hand, eyes looking past the camera, quiet thoughtful expression
camera-pose-chin-on-hand.s: an older man at a cafe table, elbow on the table, chin resting on his hand, looking out of frame

film-fresco.w: Pigment painted into wet lime plaster: matte chalky colour, soft earth tones and faded blues, visible plaster cracks and patches where paint has flaked away.
film-fresco.a: buon fresco wall painting, matte pigment in wet lime plaster, chalky ochre, terracotta and faded azure, flat simple figures, fine hairline cracks and flaked patches showing bare plaster, painted border band
film-fresco.s: shepherds and sheep resting under olive trees on a hillside, painted across a curved chapel wall

camera-pose-arms-crossed.w: Arms folded across the chest, shoulders square, direct look at the lens.
camera-pose-arms-crossed.a: arms folded across the chest, shoulders square to the camera, weight even, direct steady look into the lens
camera-pose-arms-crossed.s: a teenage skateboarder in a park

film-baroque.w: 1600s painting built on motion: diagonal compositions, billowing drapery, heavy gold and crimson, strong light and deep shadow, bodies caught mid-turn.
film-baroque.a: Baroque oil painting, sweeping diagonal composition, billowing crimson and gold drapery, figures caught mid-motion, strong directional light with deep warm shadows, rich glazes, stormy sky, visible brushwork
film-baroque.s: a ship's crew hauling ropes on a pitching deck as storm clouds break into golden light

camera-pose-walk-toward.w: Caught mid-stride walking straight at the lens, arms swinging naturally.
camera-pose-walk-toward.a: walking straight toward the camera, caught mid-stride, one foot forward, arms swinging naturally, eyes ahead
camera-pose-walk-toward.s: a woman in a red raincoat walking straight toward the camera on a city sidewalk, mid-stride, one foot forward

film-dutch-golden-age.w: 1600s Dutch oil: soft north window light across a tiled interior or a table of fruit, pewter and glass, cool walls, deep dark backgrounds, every surface rendered exactly.
film-dutch-golden-age.a: Dutch Golden Age oil painting, soft north window light from the left, quiet tiled interior, still life of lemons, pewter and a glass goblet on a dark table, cool grey walls, deep umber shadows, fine smooth brushwork
film-dutch-golden-age.s: a still life of oysters, a peeled lemon, a silver cup and a loaf on a dark table

camera-pose-stride-profile.w: Side view of the body caught between steps, legs apart, coat or hair moving.
camera-pose-stride-profile.a: side view of the body caught between steps, legs apart in a long stride, arms in motion, hair or coat moving behind
camera-pose-stride-profile.s: a man in a white shirt on a quiet city street

film-romanticism.w: Early 1800s painting of awe: tiny figures before mountains, storms and ruins, mist and moonlight, skies that take up most of the canvas.
film-romanticism.a: Romantic era oil painting, the sublime, a tiny lone figure seen from behind facing vast misty mountains, dramatic swirling storm sky, shafts of light, Gothic ruin, muted golds and cold blue-greys, loose atmospheric brushwork
film-romanticism.s: a lone traveller on a rocky ridge above a sea of fog at dawn

camera-pose-steps-sit.w: Seated on steps or a stoop, elbows on knees, leaning forward.
camera-pose-steps-sit.a: sitting on outdoor steps, elbows resting on knees, leaning forward, hands loosely together, looking off to one side
camera-pose-steps-sit.s: a young man sitting on stone steps outside a building, elbows on his knees, leaning forward

film-hudson-river-school.w: 1800s American wilderness painting: wide valleys, still lakes, waterfalls and storm-broken trees under glowing golden sky, fine detail in the foreground.
film-hudson-river-school.a: Hudson River School landscape oil painting, panoramic wilderness valley, mirror-still river, golden luminous haze, storm clouds parting, blasted tree trunk in the foreground, fine detailed foliage, warm amber and sage palette
film-hudson-river-school.s: a wilderness river valley at sunset with a waterfall and a small canoe on the water

camera-pose-crouch.w: Deep squat, forearms on the knees, low to the ground, looking at the lens.
camera-pose-crouch.a: deep low crouch, heels down, forearms resting on the knees, hands hanging, looking straight into the lens
camera-pose-crouch.s: a woman in a linen dress by a stone wall

film-pre-raphaelite.w: Victorian painting of legends and poems: sharp botanical detail everywhere, jewel-bright colour on a white ground, flowing hair, medieval robes, wistful faces.
film-pre-raphaelite.a: Pre-Raphaelite oil painting, jewel-bright saturated colour on white ground, every leaf and flower in sharp botanical detail, woman with long flowing auburn hair in a medieval velvet gown, wistful gaze, willow riverbank
film-pre-raphaelite.s: a woman in a green velvet gown reading a letter in a walled garden full of irises

camera-pose-lying-up.w: Lying on the back on grass or a bed, hair spread, seen from directly above.
camera-pose-lying-up.a: lying on the back on grass, hair spread around the head, arms loose, eyes open to the sky, seen from directly above
camera-pose-lying-up.s: a young man in a denim jacket on a hill at golden hour

film-impressionism.w: 1870s outdoor painting of light itself: quick broken strokes of pure colour, coloured shadows, soft edges, sun on water, parks and gardens.
film-impressionism.a: French Impressionist oil painting en plein air, quick broken brushstrokes of unmixed colour, dappled sunlight, violet and blue shadows, shimmering water reflections, soft edges, light airy palette, visible canvas texture
film-impressionism.s: children flying kites on a breezy beach with striped bathing tents

camera-pose-shield-eyes.w: One hand flat over the brow against the sun, looking out to the distance.
camera-pose-shield-eyes.a: one hand held flat over the brow to shade the eyes, looking out into the far distance, body turned toward the horizon
camera-pose-shield-eyes.s: a woman with short grey hair in a cafe

film-post-impressionism.w: Late 1800s painting past Impressionism: rhythmic directional strokes, bold outlines, flat areas of strong colour, skies that swirl and objects built from blocks.
film-post-impressionism.a: post-impressionist oil painting, thick rhythmic directional brushstrokes, swirling sky, bold dark contour lines, cobalt blue against chrome yellow, simplified forms built from colour patches, textured canvas
film-post-impressionism.s: a fishing harbour with red-roofed houses and moored boats at noon, wind in the flags

camera-pose-face-to-sun.w: Head tilted back, eyes closed, face turned up into warm light.
camera-pose-face-to-sun.a: head tilted back, eyes closed, face turned up into warm sunlight, shoulders relaxed, a calm small smile
camera-pose-face-to-sun.s: a tall man in a wool coat on a beach

film-pointillism.w: Pictures built entirely from small dots of pure colour that blend in the eye: complementary dots side by side, still poses, sunny parks and harbours.
film-pointillism.a: pointillist painting made entirely of small round dots of pure unmixed colour, complementary orange and blue dots side by side, optical colour mixing, calm frozen figures, sunny riverside park, visible canvas between dots
film-pointillism.s: a lighthouse and sailing boats in a harbour at noon, built entirely of small distinct dots of pure colour

camera-pose-hands-frame.w: Both hands near the face, fingertips soft along the jaw or cheek.
camera-pose-hands-frame.a: both hands raised near the face, fingertips resting softly along the jaw and cheek, relaxed fingers, calm eyes to the lens
camera-pose-hands-frame.s: a young woman with curly black hair in a park

film-fauvism.w: Early 1900s painting where colour is set free: red trees, green faces, pink skies, flat loose patches straight from the tube, little shading.
film-fauvism.a: Fauvist painting, wild non-natural colour, hot pink sky, red tree trunks, emerald and orange patches, loose bold brushstrokes straight from the tube, flat colour areas, minimal shading, sun-drenched Mediterranean harbour
film-fauvism.s: a fishing harbour with moored boats and hillside houses in the afternoon sun

camera-pose-back-to-camera.w: Seen from behind, facing a view: the place becomes the subject.
camera-pose-back-to-camera.a: seen from behind, back to the camera, standing still and facing a wide view, arms at the sides, the place fills the frame
camera-pose-back-to-camera.s: an older man with a beard in a bright apartment

film-expressionism.w: Early 1900s painting of inner feeling: jagged distorted shapes, acid greens and blood reds, harsh black contours, tilted streets and mask-like faces.
film-expressionism.a: German Expressionist painting, jagged distorted forms, harsh black outlines, acid green faces and blood-red sky, tilted angular buildings, raw slashing brushstrokes, unsettling perspective, rough unprimed canvas
film-expressionism.s: a crowded tram at night, faces as angular masks, jagged strokes, acid greens and reds

camera-pose-twirl.w: Spinning in place, a skirt, dress or coat flaring out with the motion.
camera-pose-twirl.a: spinning in place, a skirt flaring out wide with the motion, arms out for balance, hair lifting, laughing
camera-pose-twirl.s: a dancer in a flowing skirt on a quiet city street

film-cubism.w: Objects broken into flat overlapping planes and shown from several viewpoints at once: angular facets, muted browns and greys or flat synthetic colour.
film-cubism.a: Cubist painting, subject fractured into overlapping flat geometric planes, several viewpoints at once, angular facets, muted ochre, olive and grey palette, flattened space, faceted shading, collaged newsprint texture
film-cubism.s: a guitar, a wine bottle and a fruit bowl on a cafe table by a window

camera-pose-jump.w: Both feet off the ground, frozen at the top of a jump.
camera-pose-jump.a: jumping with both feet off the ground, frozen at the top of the jump, knees bent, arms flung up, big open expression
camera-pose-jump.s: a woman in a red raincoat in a sunlit studio

film-futurism.w: 1910s painting obsessed with speed: repeated overlapping forms, force lines, motion blur painted by hand, trains, cars and crowds in fragmented light.
film-futurism.a: Italian Futurist painting, dynamism of motion, repeated overlapping silhouettes of a moving figure, radiating force lines, fragmented prismatic light, speeding train and city, rust red, steel blue and electric yellow
film-futurism.s: a cyclist racing past a steam train through a city street

camera-pose-product-to-camera.w: Holding a product up beside the face toward the lens, creator style.
camera-pose-product-to-camera.a: holding a product up beside the face toward the lens, label facing camera, friendly smile, looking into the lens, arm half extended
camera-pose-product-to-camera.s: a young woman holding a plain unlabeled glass bottle by a stone wall

film-dada-collage.w: Cut-up printed matter glued into nonsense: halftone photo scraps, mismatched scale, gears and faces, stamps and tickets on yellowed card.
film-dada-collage.a: Dada photomontage collage, cut-out halftone newspaper photos glued at odd angles, mismatched scale, gears, clock faces and machine parts, torn paper edges, rubber stamps and tickets, yellowed card, red and black accents
film-dada-collage.s: a man whose head is a birdcage riding a bicycle over a map of rooftops

camera-pose-window-silhouette.w: A dark figure standing against bright window light, shape only.
camera-pose-window-silhouette.a: a figure standing in front of a bright window, body in dark silhouette, profile edge against the light, still
camera-pose-window-silhouette.s: a person standing in front of a tall bright window inside a dark room, body in black silhouette

film-surrealism.w: Dream logic painted with a realist's hand: impossible objects, long shadows on endless plains, melting or floating things, crisp light and empty sky.
film-surrealism.a: Surrealist oil painting, dream logic, impossible floating objects rendered with precise realism, endless flat plain, long hard shadows, smooth gradient sky, eerie stillness, muted ochre and cerulean
film-surrealism.s: a staircase rising out of a calm sea into the clouds, a lit window floating beside it

camera-comp-forced-perspective.w: Near and far lined up so sizes lie: a person pinches a distant tower, a hand holds the sun. The camera is low and still, focus deep so both read sharp.
camera-comp-forced-perspective.a: forced perspective composition, the near subject and a distant landmark aligned so their sizes play tricks, deep focus with both sharp, low still camera
camera-comp-forced-perspective.s: a woman pretending to hold a distant lighthouse between her fingers on a beach

film-magical-realism.w: Ordinary life painted plainly, with one wonder nobody remarks on: a whale in the street, a girl floating over the laundry, flowers growing from a coat.
film-magical-realism.a: magical realism painting, an ordinary village scene in warm earth tones painted plainly, one impossible calm wonder at its centre, smooth matte paint, soft even daylight, folk-art clarity, quiet and sincere
film-magical-realism.s: an old woman hanging laundry while a small fishing boat floats in the air above the courtyard

camera-comp-shoot-through.w: The camera looks through something: a gap in leaves, a rain-streaked window, a fence. The near layer blurs into soft shapes and frames the subject behind.
camera-comp-shoot-through.a: shot through a foreground object, out-of-focus leaves or glass softly framing the frame edges, the subject sharp behind, layered depth
camera-comp-shoot-through.s: a man reading at a cafe table seen through a rain-streaked window

film-de-stijl.w: Dutch 1917 abstraction: a grid of thick black lines dividing white rectangles and a few blocks of pure red, yellow and blue. Only horizontals and verticals.
film-de-stijl.a: De Stijl neoplasticism, asymmetric grid of thick black horizontal and vertical lines, white rectangles, a few blocks of pure primary red, yellow and blue, flat matte paint, no diagonals, no curves
film-de-stijl.s: a townhouse facade and its windows abstracted into a grid of colour blocks and black lines

camera-comp-frame-within-frame.w: A doorway, window or arch inside the picture holds the subject in a second frame. The eye goes straight to them; the surround stays darker.
camera-comp-frame-within-frame.a: frame within a frame composition, the subject framed by a doorway or arch inside the picture, the surrounding wall darker, symmetrical and still
camera-comp-frame-within-frame.s: a woman standing in a sunlit doorway at the end of a dark corridor

film-harlem-renaissance.w: Black American art, writing and music centred on 1920s and 30s Harlem. Painters ranged from flat silhouettes in rings of light to vivid street scenes and dignified portraits, with jazz, city and ancestral motifs.
film-harlem-renaissance.a: Harlem Renaissance painting, 1920s and 30s Black American life rendered with dignity, rhythmic figures, jazz-club and city-street scenes, rich layered colour, bold simplified forms, ancestral motifs
film-harlem-renaissance.s: a trumpet player on a rooftop at night with rings of light rising over the city

camera-comp-foreground-framing.w: Something near the lens, a shoulder, a plant, a railing, fills one edge of the frame in soft focus and pulls the viewer into the scene.
camera-comp-foreground-framing.a: foreground framing, a large out-of-focus object filling one edge of the frame close to the lens, the subject sharp in the middle distance, cinematic depth
camera-comp-foreground-framing.s: a street musician seen past an out-of-focus bicycle wheel in the foreground

film-abstract-expressionism.w: Postwar American abstraction: huge canvases, dripped and flung paint, slashing gestural strokes or soft hovering fields of colour. No subject, all energy.
film-abstract-expressionism.a: Abstract Expressionist painting, large gestural canvas, dripped and flung enamel paint in tangled skeins, slashing black brushstrokes over raw canvas, splatter, layered cadmium red and ochre, all-over composition
film-abstract-expressionism.s: a storm over the sea interpreted as a large gestural abstract canvas

camera-comp-partial-reveal.w: Show only part of the subject: hands, a silhouette edge, half a face behind a curtain. What is withheld makes the frame.
camera-comp-partial-reveal.a: partial reveal composition, only part of the subject visible, half hidden behind a curtain or cropped by the frame edge, the rest left to the imagination
camera-comp-partial-reveal.s: a woman's face half hidden behind a sheer curtain in soft window light

film-pop-art.w: 1960s art from ads and comics: flat primary colours, thick black outlines, enlarged comic print dots, repeated consumer objects, speech-bubble energy.
film-pop-art.a: Pop Art screenprint, flat saturated primary colours, thick black outlines, enlarged comic dot-screen shading, everyday consumer object repeated in a grid of colour variations, glossy commercial look
film-pop-art.s: a diner milkshake glass repeated in four colourways on a grid

camera-comp-leading-lines.w: Roads, rails, fences or corridors converge on the subject, pulling the eye straight to them. Usually symmetrical, often a low camera.
camera-comp-leading-lines.a: leading lines composition, strong converging lines of a road, rail or corridor drawing the eye straight to the subject at the vanishing point
camera-comp-leading-lines.s: a cyclist at the far end of a long tree-lined road

film-street-graffiti.w: Aerosol paint on brick and concrete: fat outlined shapes, drips and overspray haze, stencil layers, paste-up posters and tags building up over time.
film-street-graffiti.a: graffiti street art mural, aerosol spray paint on rough brick wall, fat outlined shapes with 3D drop shadows, paint drips, soft overspray haze, stencil layers, torn paste-up posters, fluorescent pink and electric blue
film-street-graffiti.s: a giant painted fox character on a brick wall above a bicycle rack in an alley

camera-splash-pour.w: A pour or splash stopped dead by a fast strobe: a crown of droplets hangs in the air, backlit against a dark ground. In video, very high frame-rate slow motion.
camera-splash-pour.a: high-speed liquid splash frozen mid-air, a pour hitting the glass and throwing a crown of droplets, strobe-sharp suspended drops, backlit liquid glowing, dark seamless background, in video 1000 fps slow motion
camera-splash-pour.s: orange juice pouring into a clear glass and splashing over the rim

film-mexican-muralism.w: 1920s to 50s public wall painting: solid rounded figures of workers and farmers, packed rhythmic crowds, earth reds and maize yellows, stories told across a wall.
film-mexican-muralism.a: Mexican muralism, monumental fresco mural, solid rounded stylised figures of farmers and workers, packed rhythmic crowd composition, terracotta, maize yellow, deep green and indigo, flattened perspective, story across the wall
film-mexican-muralism.s: a monumental painted wall of builders raising a bridge, broad simplified figures, earthy reds and blues

camera-location-reference-sheet.w: One location fixed on a top-down map, then six reference views of it: a wide, two high diagonals from opposite corners, two sides, and one steep view from above. Every object stays in the same place, so every later shot starts from the right view.
camera-location-reference-sheet.a: location reference sheet of one set: a top-down plan plus six views, wide at eye level, two high diagonals from opposite corners, left and right side views, a steep view from above, every object in the same place in every view
camera-location-reference-sheet.s: a top-down plan of a desert set (stone hut, three boulders, a dead tree) with six numbered camera positions and their viewing directions

film-persian-miniature.w: Small manuscript paintings in mineral colour and gold: high viewpoint, flat stacked space, tiled pavilions, flowering gardens, rocks like coral, fine brushwork.
film-persian-miniature.a: Persian miniature painting, opaque mineral pigments and gold leaf, high bird's-eye viewpoint, flat stacked space, tiled pavilion and flowering garden, coral-like rocks, lapis blue and turquoise, fine single-hair brushwork, ornamented border
film-persian-miniature.s: musicians and a falconer in a walled garden with a tiled pavilion, cypress trees and a stream

camera-cowboy-shot.w: Framed from mid-thigh up, so the hands and hips are in frame: born in westerns to keep the holster in shot, now the go-to for a character squaring up to the camera.
camera-cowboy-shot.a: cowboy shot, framed from mid-thigh up, hands and hips in frame, subject squared up to the camera, eye-level, a little headroom
camera-cowboy-shot.s: a man in a white kandura and ghutra on a Dubai souk street, framed from mid-thigh up, hands on his hips

film-mughal-painting.w: Indian court painting of the 1500s to 1700s: fine portraits and natural history, soft naturalism, pale skies, gold-flecked borders, animals and flowers drawn from life.
film-mughal-painting.a: Mughal miniature painting, opaque watercolour and gold on paper, naturalistic finely modelled figures and animals drawn from life, pale blue sky, soft green hills, gold-flecked floral border, delicate single-hair brush detail
film-mughal-painting.s: a painted elephant and its rider crossing a riverbank among flowering trees

camera-trunk-shot.w: The camera sits inside an open car trunk looking up, so the characters lean in and stare down at it, framed by the lid and the dark trunk edges: the audience becomes whatever is in the trunk.
camera-trunk-shot.a: trunk shot, camera inside an open car trunk looking up at the characters leaning over it, framed by the raised lid and dark trunk edges, bright sky behind them, low angle
camera-trunk-shot.s: a man in a white kandura and ghutra leaning over an open car trunk, seen from inside it

film-byzantine-icon.w: Egg tempera on wood under burnished gold leaf: frontal still figures, almond eyes, flat haloes, stylised drapery lines and reverse perspective.
film-byzantine-icon.a: Byzantine icon style, egg tempera on wooden panel, burnished gold leaf background, frontal solemn figure with flat halo, stylised drapery highlight lines, deep red and lapis blue, reverse perspective, aged craquelure
film-byzantine-icon.s: a lighthouse keeper holding a lantern, painted frontally on a gold ground

camera-jump-cut.w: Two shots of the same subject from almost the same angle cut straight together, so the person seems to jump in place: dead air and stumbles vanish and the pace snaps forward.
camera-jump-cut.a: jump cut edit, the same subject and nearly the same framing cut straight together, a visible skip in position, fast talking-head pacing, no transition
camera-jump-cut.s: two frames of a man in a white kandura on a Dubai souk street, the same framing, cut straight together

film-illuminated-manuscript.w: Medieval vellum pages: small flat scenes in lapis and vermilion, burnished gold, vine borders full of tiny odd creatures, no words required.
film-illuminated-manuscript.a: medieval illuminated manuscript miniature on vellum, flat figures in lapis blue and vermilion, burnished raised gold leaf, ornate ivy vine border with tiny whimsical creatures, diapered patterned background, fine ink outlines
film-illuminated-manuscript.s: peasants harvesting wheat beneath a castle in a small framed scene with a vine border

camera-zoom-transition.w: A fast zoom into the frame with radial motion blur that carries straight into the next shot, which zooms out of its own blur, so two scenes feel like one move.
camera-zoom-transition.a: zoom transition, a fast zoom in with radial motion blur into the centre of the frame, continuing into the next shot zooming out of the blur, seamless energetic cut
camera-zoom-transition.s: a man on a desert dune at the centre of a radial zoom blur

film-egyptian-tomb-painting.w: Ancient Egyptian wall painting: figures in strict composite profile, flat ochre and malachite colour, registers stacked in bands, reeds, birds and boats.
film-egyptian-tomb-painting.a: ancient Egyptian tomb wall painting, figures in composite profile with frontal eye, flat ochre, malachite green and Egyptian blue, horizontal registers, papyrus reeds, birds and river boat, flaking plaster, no hieroglyph text
film-egyptian-tomb-painting.s: fishermen casting nets from a reed boat among papyrus with birds taking flight

camera-long-exposure-water.w: A shutter open for many seconds: moving water turns to smooth mist or glass, clouds stretch into streaks, and anything still stays sharp.
camera-long-exposure-water.a: long exposure photograph, ND filter, sea smoothed into milky mist, clouds streaked across the sky, foreground rocks pin sharp, calm muted light, no camera or tripod in frame
camera-long-exposure-water.s: a wooden pier running out into a calm grey sea at dawn

film-naive-folk-art.w: Self-taught painting: flat bright colour, no true perspective, every leaf and brick painted one by one, figures stiff and charming, symmetry and pattern.
film-naive-folk-art.a: naive folk art painting, flat bright colour, no true perspective, every leaf painted individually, stiff charming figures, symmetrical patterned composition, dense jungle foliage, acrylic on board, sincere childlike clarity
film-naive-folk-art.s: a village fair on a green hill with a carousel, cows and houses all at the same scale

camera-24mm-wide.w: A true wide angle: lots of the place in frame, lines that lean toward the corners, and a subject that grows when you step close.
camera-24mm-wide.a: 24mm wide angle lens, big depth of field, lots of the setting in frame, converging lines toward the edges, subject placed close in the foreground
camera-24mm-wide.s: a hiker standing close to the lens on a mountain ridge with the valley opening out behind

film-fantasy-oil-illustration.w: Painted fantasy book cover: heroic figure in a dramatic pose, dragons, castles and storms, rich oil colour, strong rim light and loose painterly backgrounds.
film-fantasy-oil-illustration.a: fantasy oil illustration, painted book cover style, heroic figure in a dynamic pose on a cliff, dragon in a stormy sky, distant castle, rich warm and cool contrast, strong rim light, painterly loose background, tight detailed focal point
film-fantasy-oil-illustration.s: a knight in a red cloak facing a dragon on a mountain pass at sunset

camera-50mm-normal.w: The lens that sees about like your eye: no stretch, no squeeze, soft background at wide aperture. The plain, truthful frame.
camera-50mm-normal.a: 50mm normal lens at f/1.8, natural perspective like the human eye, soft out of focus background, no distortion, half body framing
camera-50mm-normal.s: a young man in a denim jacket leaning on a brick wall on a city street

film-manga-screentone.w: Japanese comic art in black ink only: crisp G-pen lines, dot screentone shading, speed lines, big expressive eyes or gritty gekiga realism.
film-manga-screentone.a: black and white manga illustration, crisp G-pen ink linework, grey dot screentone shading, radiating speed lines, expressive character with large eyes, dramatic close framing, white paper, no colour, no speech bubbles
film-manga-screentone.s: a schoolgirl leaping a rooftop gap with the city below and wind in her hair

camera-food-45.w: The angle of someone about to eat: camera 45 degrees above the plate, the front of the dish sharp and the back falling soft.
camera-food-45.a: food photograph from a 45 degree angle, the angle of a diner sitting down, plate filling the frame, shallow focus with the front of the dish sharp, soft side light, a few props blurred behind

film-construction-line-figure.w: An angular expressive figure in broken black line with the red construction lines left in: the search for the pose stays on the page, a hunched body, emotion in the hesitations.

film-schoolbook-pencil-wash.w: The old textbook plate: soft pencil drawing of children at a desk, faded watercolour laid thin over it, pale paper, every object named by its shape, an instructional calm from before screens.

film-grotto-mural-mineral.w: A flying figure with ribbons on plaster: mineral teal and red, lotus, plaster grain and faded patches where the pigment lifted, the formal ribbon-and-cloud language of grotto wall painting.

film-islamic-geometric.w: Ornament of the Islamic world from the 800s on: girih star-and-polygon lattices, arabesque tendrils, glazed tile mosaic and muqarnas honeycomb vaults, pattern that fills a surface without a centre.

film-romanesque.w: Western European church art around 1000 to 1150: stiff frontal figures with wide eyes and drapery drawn as parallel lines, carved stone capitals of beasts and vines, wall painting in earth colours under round arches.

film-maya-codex.w: Painting on folded bark paper in the Maya lowlands: figures in strict profile with a fluid black outline, flat fills of red ochre, blue green and black on cream, panels divided by red rule lines, text blocks sitting beside the picture.
film-maya-codex.a: Maya codex painting on bark paper, figures in strict profile with fluid black outline, flat fills of red ochre, blue green and black on a cream ground, panels divided by red rule lines, plain colour panels in the margins, screenfold page

film-thangka.w: Scroll painting of Tibet and the Himalaya: mineral pigments on primed cotton, fine gold line over flat lapis and malachite, stylised clouds and snow peaks, strict symmetric geometry inside a brocade border. Formal language only.
film-thangka.a: Tibetan thangka technique, mineral pigments on primed cotton, fine gold line over flat lapis blue and malachite green, swirling stylised clouds and snow peaks, symmetric composition inside a brocade border, landscape and animals only
film-thangka.s: a pair of cranes over a turquoise lake ringed by snow peaks and gold-lined swirling clouds, deer on the shore, brocade border

film-literati-ink.w: Scholar-amateur ink painting of Yuan and Ming China: dry sparse brush on soft paper, a few bare trees and angular rocks by still water, wide empty space, feeling over likeness.
film-literati-ink.a: Chinese literati ink painting, dry sparse brush on soft paper, a few bare trees and angular rocks by still water, distant low hills, wide empty space, pale ink with a little darker accent, no colour, unhurried and understated
film-literati-ink.s: three bare trees on a low bank, one angular rock, and a far ridge across empty water, dry pale ink on soft paper

film-egg-tempera.w: Pigment bound in egg yolk on a white gesso panel: thin translucent layers built with fine parallel hatching, green earth underpaint showing through pale flesh, crisp matte surface, often over gold leaf. Revived again in the 1900s.
film-egg-tempera.a: egg tempera on a white gesso panel, thin translucent layers built up with fine parallel hatching strokes, green earth underpaint showing through pale skin and foliage, crisp matte surface, gold leaf ground punched with a small dot pattern
film-egg-tempera.s: a kitchen garden in spring with a hare under bean poles, fine hatching, a gold-leaf sky punched with a dot pattern

film-encaustic.w: Pigment in molten beeswax fused to a panel with heat: thick translucent layers, scraped and ridged texture, luminous cloudy depth. Roman-era portrait technique still practised today.
film-encaustic.a: encaustic painting, pigmented beeswax fused with heat on a wood panel, thick translucent layers with soft scraped and ridged texture, waxy luminous depth, warm skin tones and dark grounds, edges melting slightly into one another
film-encaustic.s: a weathered rowing boat pulled onto shingle at dusk, layered translucent wax with scraped ridges in the water

film-mezzotint.w: Intaglio print in which the whole plate is roughened to print velvet black and the image is scraped and burnished out of the dark: tone without line, deep blacks, soft greys, small sharp highlights.
film-mezzotint.a: mezzotint print, image scraped out of a fully rocked velvet-black plate, tones emerging from darkness into soft grey and small bright highlights, no outlines, grainy burr texture, monochrome on cream paper
film-mezzotint.s: a lighthouse in a storm at night, a single lit window and spray emerging from velvet black

film-aquatint.w: Etching technique that bites tone through a dusted rosin ground: flat granular washes laid in steps like an ink drawing, fine etched line for edges, warm brown or black ink on laid paper.
film-aquatint.a: aquatint etching, flat granular tone laid in stepped washes like sepia ink wash, fine etched line for edges, speckled rosin grain visible in the mid tones, warm brown or black ink on cream laid paper, deep shadows and plain light sky
film-aquatint.s: a flooded quayside with boats tied to lamp posts and figures under umbrellas, in stepped sepia tones

film-byzantine-mosaic.w: Wall mosaic of the Eastern Roman world, 500 to 1453: small glass and gold tesserae set at angles so the ground shimmers, flat frontal figures with simple outlines, peacocks, doves and vines in coloured stone with visible grout.
film-byzantine-mosaic.a: Byzantine wall mosaic, small glass and gold tesserae set at angles so the gold ground shimmers, flat frontal figures with simple outlines, peacocks, doves and vines in green, blue, white and red stone, visible grout lines
film-byzantine-mosaic.s: two peacocks flanking a fountain under a vine, gold and green tesserae catching light at angles

film-leaded-art-glass.w: Art Nouveau glass and metalwork, 1890 to 1915: streaky opalescent glass cut and set in copper foil and lead, lamp shades of dragonflies and wisteria lit from inside, wrought iron that curls like a stem, bronze patina.
film-leaded-art-glass.a: Art Nouveau leaded glass, opalescent and streaky glass pieces set in copper foil and dark lead lines, dragonfly and wisteria lamp shade glowing from within, whiplash wrought iron curves, bronze patina, warm amber, violet and leaf green
film-leaded-art-glass.s: a hanging lamp of wisteria glass over a round table, its light pooling on an iron stair rail curling like a vine

film-echo-line-ripple.w: Every shape and letter radiates rings of parallel lines that echo outward until they fill the page, printed in two or three flat fluorescent spot inks, with a black halftone photo cut out on top. Late-1960s stamps and event graphics.
film-echo-line-ripple.a: echo-line ripple graphic, every shape outlined by many parallel contour lines rippling outward to fill the frame, flat fluorescent spot inks in magenta, orange, green and violet, one black halftone cutout, printed stamp texture
film-echo-line-ripple.s: no words, no letters. a flat poster: a single dove silhouette in the centre, with twenty evenly spaced parallel outline rings echoing outward from its shape until they fill the page, printed in only three flat inks: hot magenta, orange and green on cream paper

film-misty-bloom-poster.w: Flowers and figures dissolve into soft glowing blurs of pastel colour on a white or pale ground, with crisp small serif and sans type set around them. Bright, foggy and quiet, like a festival poster seen through frosted glass.
film-misty-bloom-poster.a: soft-focus bloom poster, out-of-focus pastel flowers glowing into a white ground, misty gradients with no hard edges, airy negative space, small crisp serif and sans type blocks, bright matte finish
film-misty-bloom-poster.s: a spring arts festival poster, large out-of-focus flowers glowing on white, small sharp type blocks

film-spectral-grain-figures.w: Simple flat figures filled with soft rainbow gradients that drift from orange to green to blue inside each shape, dusted with a fine stipple grain, on an off-white paper ground. No outlines; the colour does the drawing.
film-spectral-grain-figures.a: flat illustrated figures with no outlines, each shape filled with a soft spectral gradient blending orange, green and blue, fine stippled grain texture, off-white paper ground, simple gestures, lots of empty space
film-spectral-grain-figures.s: a saxophone player mid-leap, a simple flat silhouette with no outlines, the whole body filled with a soft rainbow gradient melting from orange to green to blue, fine stipple grain, plain off-white paper background

film-crayon-journey-map.w: A whole country drawn in coloured pencil and soft wax crayon: small landmark, food and street vignettes packed onto cream paper, all stitched together by one thin wandering ink line, with doodled stamps, hearts and handwritten place names.
film-crayon-journey-map.a: coloured pencil and wax crayon travel map illustration, dense landmark and food vignettes on cream paper, one thin continuous ink line wandering between them, visible pencil strokes and crayon grain, small doodles and handwritten labels

film-cobalt-retro-cartoon.w: Loose, confident black ink lines over flat fills of cobalt blue, tomato red, white and a touch of yellow. Characters have big noses, sideways glances and real expressions. Feels like a 1960s picture book redrawn for a modern poster or packet.

film-grain-gradient-concept.w: Flat shapes with no outlines, each filled with a soft airbrushed gradient and a fine grain, on cream paper.
